journey.title: Choose 'No symptoms' after ticking symptoms with the keyboard
journey.goal: Ticking the exclusive 'No, I do not have any of these symptoms' answer clears the symptoms ticked earlier

functionalJourney.title: Tick two symptoms with a pointer
functionalJourney.goal: Both ticked symptoms are submitted and no-symptoms stays clear

guards.title: Choose 'Do not contact me' after ticking a contact method
guards.goal: The exclusive answer in a shared-name group clears the method ticked earlier

plan.root_cause: The exclusive checkbox for 'No, I do not have any of these symptoms' contains an erroneous empty style attribute that interferes with the NHSUK checkboxes widget's exclusive logic, preventing it from clearing other checkboxes in the group when selected.
plan.repair_strategy: Remove the extraneous empty style attribute from the exclusive checkbox input while preserving the data-checkbox-exclusive and data-checkbox-exclusive-group attributes.

edits.before: <input class="nhsuk-checkboxes__input" id="symptoms-none" name="symptoms[none]" type="checkbox" value="yes" data-checkbox-exclusive data-checkbox-exclusive-group="symptoms" style="">
edits.after: <input class="nhsuk-checkboxes__input" id="symptoms-none" name="symptoms[none]" type="checkbox" value="yes" data-checkbox-exclusive data-checkbox-exclusive-group="symptoms">

plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Restores keyboard-accessible mutually exclusive behavior for the symptom group, ensuring that selecting 'No symptoms' clears any previously selected symptom checkboxes, satisfying WCAG 2.1.1 keyboard and 4.1.2 name/role/value requirements.
functional_risks: Removal of an empty style attribute has no visual impact; no known functional side effects.
verification_requirements: After the edit, journey step 5 must pass: focusing #symptoms-none and pressing Space results in form-data symptoms[cough] and symptoms[fever] being empty.
Ensure that selecting a symptom after choosing 'No symptoms' clears the exclusive option (optional but recommended).
Regression guard for the contact group must continue to pass.

attempts.failure: Edit 1 (index.html): before does not occur in the file. 1 of its lines are not in the source. not in file: "<input class=\"nhsuk-checkboxes__input\" id=\"symptoms-none\" name=\"symptoms[none]\" type=\"checkbox\" value=\"yes\" data-checkbox-exclusive data-checkbox-exclusive-grou"; closest is line 47: "<input class=\"nhsuk-checkboxes__input\" id=\"symptoms-none\" name=\"symptoms[none]\" type=\"checkbox\" value=\"yes\" data-checkbox-exclusive data-checkbox-exclusive-grou". Copy before verbatim from source_candidates.

plan.root_cause: The exclusive 'No symptoms' checkbox incorrectly includes both `data-checkbox-exclusive` and `data-checkbox-exclusive-group="symptoms"` attributes. The NHSUK checkboxes widget expects exclusive checkboxes to have only `data-checkbox-exclusive` (as seen in the working contact group), while non-exclusive checkboxes carry the group attribute. This conflict prevents the widget from clearing other checkboxes when the exclusive option is selected.
plan.repair_strategy: Remove the `data-checkbox-exclusive-group="symptoms"` attribute from the exclusive checkbox, aligning it with the pattern used in the contact group where the exclusive option has only `data-checkbox-exclusive`.

edits.before: <input class="nhsuk-checkboxes__input" id="symptoms-none" name="symptoms[none]" type="checkbox" value="yes" data-checkbox-exclusive data-checkbox-exclusive-group="symptoms">
edits.after: <input class="nhsuk-checkboxes__input" id="symptoms-none" name="symptoms[none]" type="checkbox" value="yes" data-checkbox-exclusive>

plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Restores keyboard-accessible mutually exclusive behavior for the symptom group, ensuring that selecting 'No symptoms' clears any previously selected symptom checkboxes, satisfying WCAG 2.1.1 keyboard and 4.1.2 name/role/value requirements.
functional_risks: Minimal; the change only affects the exclusive checkbox's attribute configuration.
The contact group regression guard should continue to pass as it uses the same pattern.
verification_requirements: After the edit, journey step 5 must pass: focusing #symptoms-none and pressing Space results in form-data symptoms[cough] and symptoms[fever] being empty.
Regression guard for the contact group must continue to pass.
